Tricks

These are some tricks I use to live a zen life

These aren't real tricks. I can't guarantee their success.

Nothing is Worth Stressing Over

It's true. Trust yourself to conquer what must be conquered. Don't doubt your abilities.

Find Peace within Yourself

You are everything you could ever need. Bonus: Listen to songs about solitude that have your name in it.

Examples: Greta by Stevie Nicks and Just like Greta by Van Morisson

Turn Work into a Mandatory Hangout with your Friends

Befriend all of your coworkers, so when you go to work its not dreadful.

#Effectivetactic

Let Things Go

Don't hold onto emotions (Different than supression). Recommended for people currently in pointless arguments

Go with the Flow

Let life take its course. You can't really change much anyway.
